patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the 'Patch.rpa' file from the downloaded patch archive into the 'game' folder mentioned above It's working if: The background of the main menu has changed from Rui up on stage to something more adult.
